text: Pointing to a boy, Ravi said, "He is the son of my father's only son." How is the boy related to Ravi?
explanation: Ravi's father's only son is Ravi himself. So the boy is Ravi's son.

text: A is the mother of B. B is the sister of C. C is the father of D. How is A related to D?
explanation: B and C are A's children, so C is A's son. D is C's child, so A is D's grandmother.

text: Pointing to a girl, Rahul said, "She is the daughter of my paternal grandfather's only son." How is the girl related to Rahul?
explanation: Rahul's paternal grandfather's only son is Rahul's father. His daughter is Rahul's sister.

text: P is the brother of Q. Q is the sister of R. How is R related to P?
explanation: R is a brother or sister of P, but the sex of R is not given, so the exact relation cannot be fixed.

text: If '+' means '-' and '-' means '+', find the value of 20 + 8 - 3.
explanation: Swap the signs: 20 + 8 - 3 becomes 20 - 8 + 3, which is 15.

text: Statements: All dogs are animals. All animals are living beings. Conclusions: I. All dogs are living beings. II. All living beings are dogs.
explanation: Dogs lie inside animals, and animals lie inside living beings, so all dogs are living beings. The reverse does not hold.

text: Statements: Some pens are books. All books are tables. Conclusions: I. Some pens are tables. II. All pens are tables.
explanation: The pens that are books are also tables, so some pens are tables. Nothing is said about the other pens, so II does not follow.

text: Statements: No cat is a dog. All dogs are animals. Conclusions: I. No cat is an animal. II. Some animals are not cats.
explanation: Dogs are animals and no cat is a dog, so some animals (the dogs) are not cats. Cats may still be animals, so I does not follow.

text: Statement: A survey of all the adult residents of a town found that 70% prefer to travel by train. Conclusions: I. The majority of adult residents prefer trains. II. Every adult resident prefers trains.
explanation: 70% is more than half, so the majority prefer trains. The other 30% do not, so II is false.

text: Statement: Please do not use mobile phones inside the hospital. Assumptions: I. Mobile phones may disturb the working of medical equipment. II. There are no mobile phones in the hospital.
explanation: A request not to use phones assumes they could cause a problem. It does not assume there are no phones, since people carry them.

text: Statement: All employees must wear identity cards inside the office. Assumptions: I. Identity cards help to identify employees. II. Employees dislike wearing identity cards.
explanation: The rule is made because cards help to identify people. Nothing in the statement suggests that employees dislike them.

text: I. The price of onions has risen sharply this month. II. Heavy rain destroyed much of the onion crop last month. Which is correct?
options: I is the cause and II is its effect
II is the cause and I is its effect
Both are effects of independent causes
Both are effects of the same cause
explanation: A damaged crop reduces supply and raises the price. So II is the cause and I is the effect.

text: Which of the following best shows the relationship between Dogs, Mammals and Animals?
options: Dogs lie inside Mammals, and Mammals lie inside Animals
Three separate circles that do not touch
Mammals lie inside Dogs, and Dogs lie inside Animals
Animals lie inside Mammals, and Dogs lie outside both
explanation: All dogs are mammals, and all mammals are animals, so the circles are nested: Dogs inside Mammals inside Animals.
